scope: The principal cliff-top Penglai Pavilion and its immediately attached terrace and circulation, in the configuration illustrated in the 1925 volume.

originalReview.notes: Printed page 72 shows the pavilion on a stepped stone terrace with flanking structures. The first-edition colophon gives December 1925 and The Commercial Press, Limited, Shanghai. The plate governs massing and roof silhouette. The county register supplies measured bay dimensions and exterior details.

excludedHistoricalImagery.reason: Unverified rights in the modern diorama.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla photo depicts a modern museum diorama. The photographer dedicated the photo to CC0, but the diorama itself had no verified dedication. The National Library of China’s exact public-domain 1925 print scan is the supplemental reference after checking the Qualla original.
